title: Frontend: app shell and navigation
description: Builds the persistent app shell (MUI AppBar + nav) and finalizes routing between Dashboard/Portfolio/Stock Detail. Feature pages (frontend-portfolio-page, frontend-stock-analysis-page) depend on this existing so they can be dropped into a real layout rather than a bare route.

checklist.step: AppShell.tsx: MUI AppBar + persistent NavDrawer (or equivalent responsive nav) wrapping all routed pages.
Wire real routes in App.tsx for Dashboard ('/'), Portfolio ('/portfolio'), and Stock Detail ('/stocks/:ticker'), replacing the scaffold's placeholders.
Add a top-level error boundary (React error boundary, not just TanStack Query's per-query error state) so a render-time crash in one page doesn't blank the whole app.

Component tests for AppShell/NavDrawer: nav links present, active-route highlighting, responsive behavior at narrow width (per Frontend.md's phone-width expectations carried over from the artifact-design conventions used elsewhere in this project, if applicable — otherwise decide and record a reasonable minimum-width target).
